pr_title: Add the pyocd as a runner for stm32F303 and stm32f334 nucleo boards
pr_body:
Add the pyocd as a runner for the nucleo_f303k8 and nucleo_f334r8 boards for flashing and debugging.

If the stm32f303k8tx/ stm32f334r8tx  is not in the list of targets for pyocd :
`$ pyocd list --targets`
then add the pack for pyocd
`$ pyocd pack install stm32f303`  `$ pyocd pack install stm32f334`  

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/54117

Nucleo_f334r8 and nucleo_f303k8 report the same error with openocd : unable to write the flash after erasing

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu <francois.ramu@st.com>

Rebase on 8512bd18c66699046dffb7da0b02d72301fe8e5b
Adding the stm32CubeProgrammer as a runner for west flash
Enable the debug when sleeping : makes the reflashing possible when runner is pyocd and makes the debug 'west debug' possible with pyocd   (see https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/22496)

> If I call the `pyocd list --targets | grep stm32f303` nothing returns, thus the target is not installed. When I try to install the package as you said I get the error messages described above. I wrote an [Issue on the pyocd page](https://github.com/pyocd/pyOCD/issues/1496) as soon as this is resolved I will test the changes.

For flashing you can still use the stm32cubeprogrammer, but for debugging the pyocd target pack is required.
Got it running, I'm now able to flash and debug via pyocd.

Flash is erased but not written.

However, I can flash on a nucleo_f303re (STLINK V2J39M27)

I suggest to add the pyocd runner for the boards to flash _and_ debug :
```
diff --git a/boards/arm/nucleo_f303k8/board.cmake b/boards/arm/nucleo_f303k8/board.cmake
index f061108044..294493a928 100644
--- a/boards/arm/nucleo_f303k8/board.cmake
+++ b/boards/arm/nucleo_f303k8/board.cmake
@@ -1,6 +1,10 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 
 board_runner_args(jlink "--device=STM32F303K8" "--speed=4000")
+board_runner_args(pyocd "--target=stm32f303k8tx")
+board_runner_args(pyocd "--flash-opt=-O reset_type=hw")
+board_runner_args(pyocd "--flash-opt=-O connect_mode=under-reset")
 
+include(${ZEPHYR_BASE}/boards/common/pyocd.board.cmake)
 include(${ZEPHYR_BASE}/boards/common/openocd.board.cmake)
 include(${ZEPHYR_BASE}/boards/common/jlink.board.cmake)
```

If the stm32f303k8tx is not in the list of targets for pyocd : 
`$ pyocd list --targets`
then add the pack for pyocd
`$ pyocd pack install stm32f303`


Note that flashing with pyocd will succeed after a successful flash (to be achieved with st32cube programmer for example).
